meta.name: lcx-contribute-bug-fix
meta.description: Contribute a verified bug fix for LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, bundled Codex skills, or upstream Codex CLI bugs. Opens a fork PR only for upstream openai/codex; LazyCodex-owned defects become a verified-fix issue on code-yeongyu/lazycodex (never a PR — that repo is a generated distribution mirror). Use when the user asks to fix a bug, contribute a bug fix, contribute to fix bug, open a PR for a bug, or debug and PR a LazyCodex/Codex defect.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为 LazyCodex 或 Codex 项目提交经过验证的缺陷修复
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在使用 LazyCodex 或 Codex 并想贡献修复
copy.tagline_en: Submit a verified bug fix for LazyCodex or Codex projects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use LazyCodex or Codex and want to contribute a fix

howto.what: 它会在临时目录复现缺陷、写失败测试并做最小修复,然后按目标仓库分开交付:LazyCodex 相关仓库得到附补丁的修复工单(绝不拉取请求);上游 openai/codex 得到拉取请求。不动你当前项目,最后清理临时文件。
howto.when: 当你说要修缺陷、贡献修复、为缺陷提交拉取请求等,且对象涉及 LazyCodex/Codex 时触发。

say.text: 帮我修这个 LazyCodex 的缺陷:升级后配置总被重置。
say.note: 会先复现定位,再按归属准备修复交付。

say.text: 为 openai/codex 的这个崩溃问题创建拉取请求修复。
say.note: 会创建拉取请求,附复现与验证记录。

say.text: 这个缺陷在 code-yeongyu/lazycodex,请贡献一个修复。
say.note: 会发修复工单(内含补丁),而不是拉取请求。

howto.what_en: Reproduces the bug in a temp workspace, writes a failing test, applies the smallest fix. Creates a patch-embedded fix issue for LazyCodex repos or a fork PR for openai/codex, without touching your current repo, then cleans up.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to fix a defect, contribute a fix, or open a PR for a LazyCodex/Codex defect.

say_en.text: Help me fix this LazyCodex bug: settings keep resetting after upgrade.
say_en.note: It will reproduce and route the fix delivery.

say_en.text: Open a PR to fix this crash in openai/codex.
say_en.note: It will create a fork PR with reproduction and verification logs.

say_en.text: This bug is in code-yeongyu/lazycodex; contribute a fix.
say_en.note: It will file a patch-embedded issue, not a PR.
